summary: The image editor has a centered zoom icon toolbar and a separate read-only percentage display.
Ctrl+click an inactive clip to start Multi-paste with both it and the active clip selected.
The Multi-paste button starts empty. Unselected clips have no active border or tint.
No automated or interactive test suites were run; functional acceptance is deferred to manual testing.
Multi-paste image clips as separate attachments or inline images; Ctrl+E opens format and order options.
Advanced Image Paste adds zoom controls, Ctrl+wheel zoom and panning.
Double-click a clip header or blank space beneath its content to paste. Double-click and drag text to select words.
Ctrl+S saves the shown clip; change or disable the shortcut in Settings.
Windows, X11 and experimental GNOME 46 packages ship together. Live ChatGPT and document-editor compatibility remains for manual testing.
Update downloads retry GitHub gateway failures and recover through the GitHub release API.
If both GitHub routes fail, the updater uses the signed pasteroll.com mirror.
Manifest signatures and SHA-256 checks remain mandatory.
Existing history, keys, settings and rolls are kept.
Ctrl+click an image clip in the carousel to open Advanced Image Paste.
Ctrl+click text and file clips still chooses them for Multi-paste.
Windows update downloads retry transient GitHub gateway failures.
Existing history, keys, settings and rolls are kept.
Linux now includes rolls, favorite tiles, pinning, dragging, No Bloat, multi-paste and the image editor.
Windows adds the local read-only MCP agent brain for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.
The X11 and experimental GNOME 46 Wayland packages use the matching protocol 4 companion.
Windows and Linux downloads now ship together with one SHA256SUMS file.
Rolls split history into separate collections, with LEFT and RIGHT beside Main.
The carousel can stay open and be dragged by an empty margin.
Pins were renamed Favorites; Ctrl+F makes a favorite from the clip in view.
Mouse multi-paste and the Paste button work while the carousel is pinned open.
Fixed Download and install refusing to update when an old pasteroll-update folder was present.
Existing history, key and settings locations did not change.
Favorite clips appear as colored tiles with previews above the list.
The image editor gained drawing, text and recoloring tools.
